```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    items = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)].copy()

    merged = items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    # Только заказы, совершённые до seed_time
    merged = merged[merged["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]

    if merged.empty:
        features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
        features["has_history"] = 0
        features = features.fillna(0)
        return features.reindex(entity_ids)

    merged["days_to_seed"] = (seed_time - merged["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days

    group = merged.groupby("product_id")

    total_orders = group["order_id"].nunique()
    total_items = group.size()
    total_revenue = group.apply(lambda x: (x["price"] + x["freight_value"]).sum())
    avg_price = group["price"].mean()
    avg_freight = group["freight_value"].mean()
    median_price = group["price"].median()
    std_price = group["price"].std()
    min_price = group["price"].min()
    max_price = group["price"].max()
    n_sellers = group["seller_id"].nunique()

    avg_days = group["days_to_seed"].mean()
    min_days = group["days_to_seed"].min()
    max_days = group["days_to_seed"].max()
    median_days = group["days_to_seed"].median()
    std_days = group["days_to_seed"].std()

    span_days = (max_days - min_days + 1).replace({0: np.nan})
    order_freq = total_orders / span_days

    avg_items_per_order = total_items / total_orders
    avg_revenue_per_order = total_revenue / total_orders

    features = pd.DataFrame({
        "total_orders": total_orders,
        "total_items": total_items,
        "total_revenue": total_revenue,
        "avg_price": avg_price,
        "avg_freight": avg_freight,
        "median_price": median_price,
        "std_price": std_price,
        "min_price": min_price,
        "max_price": max_price,
        "n_sellers": n_sellers,
        "avg_days_to_seed": avg_days,
        "min_days_to_seed": min_days,
        "max_days_to_seed": max_days,
        "median_days_to_seed": median_days,
        "std_days_to_seed": std_days,
        "order_freq": order_freq,
        "avg_items_per_order": avg_items_per_order,
        "avg_revenue_per_order": avg_revenue_per_order,
        "has_history": 1
    })

    # Активность в окнах
    for window, col in [(30, "orders_30"), (60, "orders_60"), (90, "orders_90"),
                        (180, "orders_180"), (365, "orders_365")]:
        sub = merged[merged["days_to_seed"] <= window]
        if not sub.empty:
            features[col] = sub.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        else:
            features[col] = 0

    # Доставленные заказы: только те, что доставлены ДО seed_time
    delivered = merged[merged["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
                       & (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)].copy()
    if not delivered.empty:
        delivered["delivery_days"] = (delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
                                      - delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
        delivered["late"] = (delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
                             > delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).astype(int)
        g = delivered.groupby("product_id")
        features["n_delivered"] = g["order_id"].nunique()
        features["avg_delivery_days"] = g["delivery_days"].mean()
        features["late_ratio"] = g["late"].mean()
    else:
        features["n_delivered"] = 0
        features["avg_delivery_days"] = 0
        features["late_ratio"] = 0

    # Отзывы: только те, что созданы ДО seed_time (иначе утечка)
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][["order_id", "review_score"]].drop_duplicates("order_id")
    merged_rev = merged[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(rev, on="order_id", how="inner")
    if not merged_rev.empty:
        g_rev = merged_rev.groupby("product_id")
        avg_review = g_rev["review_score"].mean()
        num_reviews = g_rev["review_score"].count()
        merged_rev["positive"] = (merged_rev["review_score"] >= 4).astype(int)
        pos_reviews = g_rev["positive"].sum()
        positive_ratio = pos_reviews / num_reviews.replace(0, np.nan)
        features["avg_review_score"] = avg_review
        features["num_reviews"] = num_reviews
        features["positive_reviews"] = pos_reviews
        features["positive_ratio"] = positive_ratio
    else:
        features["avg_review_score"] = 0
        features["num_reviews"] = 0
        features["positive_reviews"] = 0
        features["positive_ratio"] = 0

    # Платежи: только по заказам, совершённым до seed_time
    pay = payments[payments["order_id"].isin(set(merged["order_id"]))].copy()
    if not pay.empty:
        g_pay = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
            pay_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
            pay_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
            n_payments=("payment_sequential", "max"),
        )
        pay["is_credit_card"] = (pay["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(int)
        g_pay["is_credit_card"] = pay.groupby("order_id")["is_credit_card"].max()
        pay_feat = merged[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates("order_id").merge(
            g_pay, on="order_id", how="left").groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_pay_value=("pay_value", "mean"),
            avg_installments=("pay_installments", "mean"),
            credit_card_ratio=("is_credit_card", "mean"),
        )
        features = features.join(pay_feat)

    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    return features
```
